targets.title: Feeling the future: Experimental evidence for anomalous retroactive influences on cognition and affect.
targets.evidence_quote: We set out to replicate Bem’s experiment in a purely confirmatory fashion. First we detailed our method, design, and planned analyses in a document that we posted online before a single participant was tested.
targets.outcome_quote: All tests yield evidence in favor of the null hypothesis. In other words, all confirmatory studies yielded evidence against the hypothesis that people can look into the future.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The concluding verdict explicitly rejects the original precognition finding across all confirmatory tests.
